subject: [PATCH v2 8/8] selftests/nfsd: add a cross-namespace control-plane soak

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to the NFS daemon (NFSD) that exercises its control plane from multiple namespaces simultaneously, testing lock nesting and serialization between namespaces. The test runs for a specified amount of time, during which each namespace churns through various operations, including starting and stopping servers, emptying listener sets, and reading file caches. The test also checks for lockdep splats and refcount saturation, and reports any failures or warnings. The patch includes configuration options to control the number of namespaces and the duration of the test.
